newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cie Bancaire jumps on units' buyout bid.
newsitem.headline: Cie Bancaire jumps on units' buyout bid.

text.p: Shares of French retail financial services firm Cie Bancaire on Wednesday climbed sharply after it announced bids to buy out its two units, Cardif and UFB Locabail, for a maximum three billion francs.
Cie Bancaire, majority owned by financial group Paribas, said the offers were aimed at increasing its profitability.
At 1012 GMT, Cie Bancaire's shares were up 7.41 percent or 51 francs at 739 francs, while Paribas shares were up 5.14 percent at 407 francs.
"It's a very good operation," said EIFB analyst Sami Gotrane. "It will increase profits."
The head of equities sales at a big French brokerage also praised the move, saying it heralded Cie Bancaire's transformation into an operating company from a holding company.
Brokerage Massonaud said the buy-outs would enhance earnings by about five percent.
